extraction.text:
SHRUTI KUMARI

Data Quality | Data Governance Analyst Bengaluru, India | 9920342156| Shrutijha2608@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Data Governance and Data Quality Analyst with 6+ years of experience in financial services, specializing in data governance frameworks, data quality controls, metadata management, and stakeholder collaboration. Proven ability to translate business requirements into structured data solutions, support data catalog initiatives, and drive adoption through documentation, training, and governance standards. Experienced in working with cross-functional teams including Data Owners and Data Stewards to ensure high-quality, compliant, and well-governed data assets.

CORE SKILLS (ATS KEYWORDS)

Data Governance & Data Quality

Data Catalog & Metadata Management

Business Requirement Gathering & User Stories

Data Mapping & Data Modeling Basics

Data Quality Rules, KPIs & Validation

Stakeholder Management (Business & Technical Teams)

Documentation & Data Standards (Glossary, Metadata)

Functional Testing & UAT Support

Change Management & Training Support

Tools: Excel, SQL, Collibra (basic), APIs, CRM Systems

Stakeholder Collaboration & Escalation Handling

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

MDM & Data Quality: Informatica IDQ (DQ rules, validation), MDM concepts

CRM Systems: Salesforce (preferred exposure)

Analytics & Reporting: Excel (Advanced), Power BI, Tableau

Databases: SQL (Basic–Intermediate)

Techniques: Match/Merge, deduplication, data profiling, reconciliation

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

JPMorgan Chase & Co. — Data Management Specialist

Nov 2021 – Present | Bengaluru

Govern and maintain high-quality reference data aligned with enterprise data governance standards

Collaborate with Data Owners and Data Stewards to define data ownership, metadata, and quality rules

Translate business requirements into structured data mapping and functional specifications

Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis for data quality issues

Support metadata management initiatives including business glossary and data lineage documentation

Assist in onboarding datasets into governance frameworks and catalog-like environments

Conduct data quality checks using defined KPIs, thresholds, and validation rules

Participate in UAT and functional testing for data-related system enhancements

Prepare documentation including data definitions, mapping logic, and governance standards

HighRadius Technologies — Market Research Analyst

Jun 2021 – Nov 2021

Supported customer and account data quality initiatives, including cleansing, standardization, and enrichment

Monitored data quality metrics, identified gaps in customer attributes, and supported remediation efforts

Conducted account profiling to ensure industry, geography, and contact completeness

Collaborated with Sales and Operations teams to maintain clean and usable customer datasets

SiliconIndia Technologies Pvt. Ltd. — Market Research Executive

Aug 2018 – Feb 2020

Maintained and enriched customer and company master datasets across global markets

Standardized customer attributes such as industry classification, geography, and address data

Performed regular data audits, validation, and deduplication using Excel and external data sources

Supported stakeholders with accurate customer data for reporting and business analysis

DATA GOVERNANCE & PROCESS COLLABORATION

Participation in data governance forums and working groups

Contribution to data standards, policies, and best practices

Acted as a point of contact for customer data issues, queries, and escalations

Strong documentation practices supporting compliance and audits

REPORTING & MONITORING

Customer data quality scorecards

Completeness and duplication metrics

Trend analysis and risk identification

Power BI / Tableau dashboards for data health monitoring

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) – Computer Science Engineering Bengal College of Engineering & Technology, Durgapur
